propositions: Generate CLI reference documentation syntax sections deterministically from registry enumeration and committed package-help bytes rather than regex parsing and curated command tables.
Eliminate manual command/usage/option census sources (INTERCEPT_COMMANDS, source regex) and validate all editorial content against registry spellings.
Replace hand-reconstructed route unions in tests with canonical registry enumeration via derive_policy_sets() and route attributes.
A clean no-extras wheel must render every approved help form with byte-identical committed output and no heavy import side effects.
Full-extra contract must resolve all lazy handler/parser/selector references and validate every capability-to-extra mapping without executing command logic.
The same local commands and CI checks must run portably, with rebar-mcp tested as a separate entry point.
